g.text: ONE PROBLEM. MULTIPLE WAYS. SCORE YOUR MASTERY.

text.tspan: Confidence grows by solving in multiple ways.
Reward each approach with tactile score tokens:
1 Block = +10 (1st Way) • 2 Blocks = +20 (2nd Way)
Stacking a 2nd token rewards a 2nd solution method!

g.text: • 1st Way: Seat 1 token in socket 1–10 (+10 pts)
• 2nd Way: Stack 2nd token on top (+20 pts total)

text.tspan: Storage bin holds all 60 tokens under Snapfinity lid.
Use 12 lid sockets (1–10, 100, ?) for daily practice!

g.text: TOTAL: 60 Universal +10 Tokens + 7U Bin + Lid = 62 Parts
• Interchangeable Tokens: All 60 quarter-blocks are +10 pts.
• Red+Gold Silk (30x): Seat for 1st Way solution (+10 pts).
• Glow-in-the-Dark Yellow (30x): Stack on top for 2nd Way (+20 pts)!
• High Visibility: Easy to tally scores at a glance.

text.tspan: Classroom manipulatives get lost. Never abandon
an incomplete set! Every individual math component
is permanently stocked for single replacements.

g.text: Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts

text.tspan: No inner sorting tray needed! Sweep all 60
universal +10
tokens directly into the open 3x1x7U
Gridfinity bin, lay
this reference card on top, and snap the
Scoreboard Lid
shut for silent, zero-rattle classroom
storage.
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step
hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage
arrangements, and calculator cross-references!
Keep this card stored inside the box lid!

g.text: Designed in Mountain View, California, USA • Non-Toxic BPA-Free.

text.tspan: Solving one problem in two independent ways builds deeper
mastery than solving ten by rote.
